title: Lambu Giraffe Reaches the Sky | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Lambu the giraffe stretches his long neck to rescue a red balloon from a tall tree.
This fun song teaches kids about helping friends, sharing, and never giving up.
Sing along and count the 'Wheee!' moments together!

Lambu the giraffe, look up high
A red balloon is stuck, bob, bob, bob
Such a tall, tall tree, stretch, stretch, stretch
Oh no, a balloon for you!

Wheee! Lambu's long neck goes up and up
Wheee! Up, up, up to the big blue sky
Up and up and up we go
Wheee! Lambu reaches way up high!

The kids climb up, climb up, climb up
Branch so high, oh-oh, oh-oh
Grab it, grab it, grab it, grab it - it's gone!
Bobbing, bobbing far away

Wheee! Lambu's long neck goes up and up
Wheee! Up, up, up to the big blue sky
Up and up and up we go
Wheee! Lambu reaches way up high!

Lambu bends down, slow, slow, slow
His long, long neck curls just like a hook
Bend the branch, bring it down, down, down
The balloon floats to little sister's hand!

Wheee! Lambu's long neck goes up and up
Wheee! Up, up, up to the big blue sky
Up and up and up we go
Wheee! Lambu reaches way up high!

Little sister hugs the balloon so tight
Lambu smiles a smile so big and wide
Clap and cheer, clap and cheer, everyone cheer!
Wheee, wheee, hooray for Lambu!
